2 ==========================================================
This First Appeal filed under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, is against the judgment and award dated 31.08.2021 passed in M.A.C.P. No.127 of 2019 on the file of Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (Main) at Dahod partially allowing the claim petition.

entities.text: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (Main) at Dahod
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This appeal coming on for conciliation before Lok Adalat, the NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/2460/2022 CONCILIATION ORDER DATED: 08/03/2025 undefined following order is passed :
CONCILIATION ORDER 1.

With consent, the parties have submitted the compromise pursis, as the matter has been compromised between them and additionally, compensation of Rs.10,00,000/-
including interest and costs is to be deposited by the respondent No.2 within 30 days after the receipt of the web copy of the order of the disposal of the first appeal on verification.

The parties admit to the terms of compromise and in view of the compromise pursis, the respondent No.2 to deposit the amount of Rs.10,00,000/-
before the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Dahod.
2.
The order passed in this appeal shall not be treated as precedent.
3. Necessary Court fees, if any, be refunded to the appellant, as per the provisions of Section 21(1) of the Legal Services Authority Act, 1987.

4. After the amount is deposited by the Respondent No.2, the amount shall be disbursed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/2460/2022 CONCILIATION ORDER DATED: 08/03/2025 undefined at Dahod to the claimants on due verification as per the apportionment and manner in the order of the Tribunal.

entities.text: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/2460/2022 CONCILIATION ORDER DATED: 08/03/2025
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 5. Since the appeal is compromised, the claimed amount lying with the bank in the form of FDs/ lying either with the Tribunal or with the Nazir Branch of this Court may be disbursed in favour of the claimants after due verification by way of RTGS/NEFT.
6. In view of above, the first appeal is disposed of as compromised.
7. Registry is directed to transmit the record and proceedings to the Tribunal forthwith.
